author: Rowan

queue.position: Final Cedar implementation task after the agreed chemistry, integration and reporting scope; before final combined regression and merge review.

purpose: Name the NASolve workflow AutoPhase while explicitly crediting Phenix AutoSol as its phasing engine.
proposed_description: AutoPhase — NASolve’s guarded MR-SAD workflow using Phenix AutoSol.

audit_scope.remote_verification: GitHub compare_commits returned identical for each local head versus its named branch during the audit; recheck before implementation.
audit_scope.count_caveat: Search hits, not required edits; historical and native-tool references intentionally retain AutoSol.
excluded: Historical artifact contents beyond source references

boundaries.action: Add autophase command and display naming; retain autosol as an alias to the same implementation. Normalize show/campaign stage aliases once at input boundaries.
constraints: No second executor or duplicate stage
Do not describe planned commands as already available
Preserve historical notes and accurate Phenix attribution

boundaries.action: Keep vendor executable, PHIL keys and native filenames unchanged.
constraints: Preserve original Phaser-model guidance, build=False, phase_improve_and_build=False, site and processor checks, and scientific acceptance thresholds

boundaries.action: Retain existing internal and on-disk identifiers for the initial rename. No migration of immutable runs or rehashing of frozen policy/receipts.
constraints: Persisted messages may be recomputed during receipt validation: display-only wording must not invalidate old publications
Existing AutoSol directories still prevent overwrite through either command alias

boundaries.action: Preserve approved-phase, wavelength, map and checkpoint references and disabled-policy behavior.
preserve: Disabled synthetic controls never launch native phasing

branch_reconciliation.classification: Pre-existing correctness discrepancy; separate from naming
branch_reconciliation.finding: Alder returns an exact complete HL quartet; other audited heads return anomalous observation labels into refinement_data_phase_labels.
branch_reconciliation.action: Reconcile as its own reviewed correctness change; preserve exact-quartet, family-priority and anomalous-observation checks. Do not blindly cherry-pick the entire mixed-purpose commit.

branch_reconciliation.finding: Cedar validates checked preparation through checkpoints._validate_preparation and translates CheckpointError; the other audited implementations lack this addition.
branch_reconciliation.action: Preserve this check alongside the phase-label fix. Do not replace whole files across branches.

audit_validation.mode: Read-only source/history comparison plus isolated synthetic function probe

synthetic_phase_probe.method: Extract _contains_label, anomalous_labels, _hl_labels and _discover_refinement_data via Python AST from git show REF:src/nasolve/autosol.py; stub _run_mtz_dump and use a temporary placeholder overall_best_refine_data.mtz.
synthetic_phase_probe.mtz_dump_text:
I(+) 1 K
SIGI(+) 1 M
I(-) 1 K
SIGI(-) 1 M
HLA 1 A
HLB 1 A
HLC 1 A
HLD 1 A
synthetic_phase_probe.limitation: Confirms column selection in the isolated source functions, not a native Phenix refinement result.

implementation_order: Recheck current branch heads and prior fixes; retain one shared reviewed naming implementation with branch-specific adaptations.
Introduce public AutoPhase attribution and command/display aliases without changing saved identities or native protocol.

Review all public stage/configuration surfaces. If adding an autophase recipe alias, normalize new input before freezing and reject simultaneous aliases; preserve old policy bytes/hashes. Keep old Python imports callable.
Run focused compatibility checks on affected branches, then final combined-source regression and integration review.
acceptance_checks: Old/new CLI aliases dispatch exactly once and build identical phenix.autosol argv with unchanged autosol.* keys and effective-settings validation.
Show and campaign endpoint aliases resolve to one canonical stage; discovery does not mistake a stage directory for a dataset.
Historical reports, checkpoints, receipts and frozen policies replay without byte, timestamp or digest rewrites.
Existing partial AutoSol output remains immutable through the new alias.
Ready/review/warning/skipped/disabled outcomes keep their existing refinement and phase-approval gates.
If configuration aliases are added, conflicting aliases refuse explicitly rather than silently winning.
Preserve Cedar preparation validation and Alder exact HL quartet regression coverage.
Relocated runs remain usable through declared anchors/checksums, with original paths unavailable; record platform coverage.
Final combined source passes the full suite before integration; no merge follows automatically.
deferred_optional_work: Physical AutoPhase directories or renamed persisted schema keys need a separate versioned migration/dual-reader design; not required for attribution.
A new Python module facade is optional; avoid moving implementation merely to match branding.
non_goals: Change chemistry, phosphates/OP3, Free-R, NARestraints ownership or crystallographic thresholds
Rewrite old scientific runs or historical evidence
Merge experimental branches as part of documentation
Start rename implementation ahead of Q04/Q05
